integrity: The maximal-matching census and stochastic inequalities are exact finite calculations; the verifier corroborates the separately reported kinetic law used in the comparison.
scientific_limitations: Exact comparison of random greedy and uniform maximal size for the twenty-vertex dodecahedral graph only. The greedy law is credited to a separate same-day record; no chronological priority, universal stochastic dominance, or finite-time kinetic formula is asserted.
title: Strict stochastic dominance of greedy over uniform maximal matching size on the dodecahedral graph
